candidate_sentences.text: The group achieved total revenue of €208 million, representing a decrease of approximately 7% from €224 million in 2024.
Profitability margins narrowed across the board.

The gross margin decreased by one percentage point to 6.5%, down from 7.5% in 2024, as the group faced upward pressure from rising material prices, evidenced by a 1.5% increase in the construction price index, alongside escalating labor and machinery operating costs.
The operating margin similarly contracted to 2.7% from 3.6%.

Foreign exchange fluctuations further pressured bottom-line results; the depreciation of the Ukrainian hryvnia against the euro by approximately 12% generated a translation loss of €0.8 million on intercompany loans.
Consequently, net profit declined sharply to €2.5 million from €5.2 million in the previous year, with net profit attributable to parent shareholders falling to €1.4 million from €3.8 million.
Earnings per share dropped to €0.05.
